interface.short_description: Prepare a reviewed candidate and await owner approval
interface.default_prompt: Use $mc-commit-supervisor for this accepted integration assignment; prepare the reviewed running candidate and exact owner packet, then wait for my operation-specific approval.
Use $mc-code-review-orchestrator to review this assigned integration candidate and return its raw evidence and findings to the Commit Supervisor.

interface.short_description: Repair assigned integration findings as a leaf worker
interface.default_prompt: Use $mc-commit-repair-worker to repair these assigned findings under established intent and return evidence for the Commit Supervisor's independent handoff review.

interface.short_description: Restore coordination and route completed builds
interface.default_prompt: Use $mission-control to establish this task's Mission Control role and restore its durable state. Keep monitoring inactive until I instruct you to monitor.

interface.short_description: Run hourly Status checks until the cycle ends
interface.default_prompt: Use $monitor in this assigned role to enable one hourly Status cycle. Continue for incremental progress and stop before completion, next actions or supervisor review.

interface.short_description: Report incremental progress from current evidence
interface.default_prompt: Use $status to build on the previous status, inspect current assigned-work evidence and return a role-appropriate progress report with explicit events and unknowns.

interface.short_description: Execute roadmaps with owner acceptance per SPEC
interface.default_prompt: Use $mc-roadmap-implementation-supervisor to finish each approved SPEC through fail-forward delegated execution, assess every deviation, and obtain explicit owner acceptance before starting the next SPEC.
